column1: # Hospitals accounted for 44.5% of California commercial health spending in 2024: 31.5% outpatient and 13.0% inpatient.

# Source: California Department of Health Care Access and Information (HCAI), Office of Health Care Affordability, Health Care Spending Trends in California, 2023-2024. "Everything else" (physicians, other professionals, and other services) is 100% minus the three shares the report gives.
